nodes.title: Round 7 A8 part 2 (PIPELINE §A Brain item 7, product policy): frustration on a card (mujhse nahi hoga, too hard) changes the approach and never re-poses. The card is left for later with no verdict, and the idea is taught again another way, empathy line first. Without a card, the re-explanation with the empathy line runs as before. Kill switch TAXILA_R7_FRUSTRATION=off: a hint rung on the same question.

md.decisions:
## dc-r7-brain-frustration-new-way (2026-11-04, stream A Brain)

A frustrated child who hears the same question again (with a hint) hears that nothing changed. The owner asks that something change: a different way into the idea, with the hard question set aside. It comes back later through the queue like any left card.
